stemMd: A town added bus services, and total bus journeys increased. Yet the share of all journeys made by bus decreased. Which would best explain this?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The total number of journeys by all transport modes increased faster than bus journeys did.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Some new services ran at weekends.

options.label: C
options.textMd: A bus journey can carry more people than a car journey.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Some buses were painted a new colour.

explanationMd: Distinguish absolute volume from relative share. A numerator can rise while its fraction falls if the denominator grows proportionately faster. Compare bus journeys with all journeys, not with last year's bus total alone.

distractorRationale.d: Stable fares do not determine the denominator.
distractorRationale.b: Weekend operation does not by itself explain the falling proportion.
distractorRationale.e: Paint does not change the relationship between a count and its share.
distractorRationale.c: Capacity alone does not establish growth rates.
